mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_listing (enterprise_id, agent_id, listed, hire_policy, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{enterpriseId}, #{agentId}, #{listed}, #{hirePolicy}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{now}) AS proposed ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE listed = proposed.listed, hire_policy = proposed.hire_policy, updated_by = proposed.updated_by, updated_at = proposed.updated_at
